title: Uniting the People and Technology That  Move The World
subtitle: Improving Logistics and Supply Chain Productivity, Performance, and Security
offer: Whether you want to reduce delivery costs, improve route efficiency, strengthen compliance or simplify complex logistics processes, Descartes provides software to help you operate more effectively. Descartes solutions include route optimisation and delivery scheduling, delivery tracking and customer notifications, telematics, driver and vehicle compliance, warehouse and transportation management systems, customs and denied party screening, all helping you to improve productivity, visibility and control across your supply chain.
